body.guidance: Candidate lesson from discovery-add and discovery-complete; not approved knowledge. Workboard requires Node 22+. features/*.mjs export run(board, input); cli.mjs discovers commands, owns load/save through storage/file.mjs, and saves only when serialized board changes. Features operate in memory and return JSON-serializable values. domain/board.mjs provides createBoard, validateBoard, transaction and view. Use transaction(board, operation, draft => ...) for mutations: it validates before/after, commits the draft, and returns cloned data. Audit entries {sequence: events.length+1, operation} are added only when serialized items change; board-level metadata changes alone do not trigger an entry. view validates and clones items for isolated query/report results. domain/records.mjs provides makeRecord, requireRecord, canonicalLabels and day. IDs/revisions are positive safe integers; IDs are unique and nextId exceeds all IDs. Titles are trimmed/nonempty; priorities are 1–3; labels are trimmed, lowercase, deduplicated, nonempty and sorted; dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates or absent. features/add.mjs uses makeRecord with draft.nextId, appends once and increments nextId once; defaults are open, priority 2, labels [], due null, revision 1. features/complete.mjs uses requireRecord: open becomes done with revision +1; done is idempotent; archived throws. Invalid inputs and ID/revision overflow were checked for rollback; returned data was checked for isolation. Verification observed: node --test test/*.test.mjs, node --check features/complete.mjs, and focused node --input-type=module assertions for defaults, normalization, events, idempotence, aliasing and rollback. Each feature passed six independent behavioral checks.
body.appliesWhen: Evaluating future Workboard query, reporting, metadata or workflow features against the observed in-memory feature API, validation, transaction and persistence boundaries.
body.doNotApplyWhen: The repository contracts have changed, or requirements concern unobserved schemas, query semantics, concurrency, performance or richer audit history. These runs do not establish those behaviors.
